headline: Oil and Gas Run Dry: Belt and Road Small Nation Relies on Its Savings; Reserves Could Be Exhausted ‘By This Time’ - Financial Channel
summary: Timor-Leste's oil and gas fields, which supported the national budget for more than 20 years, stopped production last June. The country is now drawing on savings during its economic transition.
why: Timor-Leste depends heavily on petroleum revenue from its offshore fields to fund its state budget.
